Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026 (15 days from the date of publication of advertisement).
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Ministry of Heavy Industries to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Consultant Grade-I post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Ministry of Heavy Industries Consultant Grade-I recruitment is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the post of Consultant Grade-I (Technical) under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant Grade-I position will receive a monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in a relevant subject or a BE/B.Tech degree to be eligible for this consultant position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Consultant Grade-I post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates are required to fill out the form using the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview conducted in either online or offline mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, the official notification does not mention any application fee for the Consultant Grade-I recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. What experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants need at least 3 years of experience in PSUs, Government, Research Organizations, or Industry, specifically with familiarity in Manufacturing, Capital Goods, or Heavy Engineering sectors.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply if I am over 45 years old?
faq.answer: No, the notification specifies that the candidate must be below 45 years of age to be eligible for the Consultant Grade-I post.
